tool.name: scFv-pMPNN
tool.description: Antibody scFv design and optimization using ProteinMPNN

param.name: input_structure
param.label: Input antibody structure
param.help: PDB or mmCIF file of the scFv or antibody structure

param.name: num_designs
param.label: Number of designs
param.help: Number of sequence designs to generate

param.name: temperature
param.label: Sampling temperature
param.help: Lower values give more conservative designs

param.name: fixed_positions
param.label: Fixed positions
param.help: Comma-separated list of positions to keep fixed (e.g., 1,2,3,50-60)

param.name: target_chains
param.label: Target chains
param.help: Chains to redesign (e.g., H,L for heavy and light chains)

tool.help:
**scFv-pMPNN: Antibody Design with ProteinMPNN**
Specialized antibody sequence design tool based on ProteinMPNN, optimized for scFv and Fab fragments.
**Input:** - Antibody structure (PDB/mmCIF format) - Optional: positions to keep fixed
**Output:** - FASTA file with designed sequences - Each sequence includes predicted stability scores
**Features:** - CDR loop optimization - Framework region preservation - Humanization support - Multi-chain design
**Citation:** ProteinMPNN: Robust sequence design using deep learning (2022) Antibody-specific extensions (2024)
